sourceStatus: working tree before commit; exact C# source/test hashes were captured before the final regression and confirmed afterward
qualification: Dedicated signed desired request domain and exact hashed host request/reply subjects; strict missing/duplicate/unknown-field rejection and bounded wire sizes.
Enrollment role/environment/node/region, session epoch/generation and request freshness are checked against current durable sessions; report authorization retains its own proof domain.
Positive desired reads use unchanged CAS; concurrent deletion/replacement and stale session replicas cannot authorize stale positives. Session authority is rechecked before returning desired data.
Missing/deleted desired is clean absence; invalid producer records, unknown artifact kinds, unavailable stores and contention are distinct failures.
Actual restricted JWT/mTLS R3 hosts read different roles and cannot access controller KV or object stores. Production controller startup and actual core convergence consume the protocol.
Bounded asynchronous/synchronous stalled storage, renewal independence, one unfinished store operation, cross-host retry status, wrong/expired/malformed/cancelled replies and revocation during reads.
Authenticated operator status and bounded outcome/in-flight/retry telemetry; typed convergence source and immutable current session signer.
limitations: Five normal-suite opt-in skips: two containerd, one live TerraBase fleet, two Firecracker VM lanes; earlier rehearsal receipts are separate.
An early main-suite run was interrupted to tighten the artifact-kind validation. Its log is not a passing qualification; this receipt uses the completed rerun.
Desired selection is an instant read, not an execution lease, artifact capability, OCI grant or guarantee against a future target update/revocation.
No production host entry is enabled. Artifact retrieval, durable backoff and regional replacement leases still require restricted protocols.
Supervisor recovery before authentication, external-command and daemon-job quiescence, storage writer fencing and controller drain receipts remain open.
First boot, founding peer delivery/quorum, seed ownership transfer, regional resource lifecycle, retained-volume lifecycle and complete fleet status remain open.
No OCI mutations or OpenTofu apply/state edits; no live guest Instance Principal or native ARM64 service qualification in this batch.
